discoveries.title: Unified Journey Planner
discoveries.discovery: A single national platform that aggregates all routes, schedules, and real-time prices from all operators to help passengers find and compare options.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 1 outlines a unified journey planner aggregating routes, schedules, and prices.

discoveries.title: Transparent Fares Display
discoveries.discovery: Clearly display all ticket types, their terms, and the total cost upfront, including applicable railcard discounts.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 1 and 2 mention transparent cost estimates, total cost, and automatic application of registered railcard discounts.
discoveries.open_question: How will SmartRail manage existing multi-operator fare structures and potential split-ticketing options to ensure passengers get the best value?

discoveries.title: Detailed Accessibility Information and Filtering
discoveries.discovery: Integrate comprehensive, verified accessibility information for every station and rolling stock type, enabling passengers to filter by specific needs such as step-free access or accessible toilets.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 1 details accessibility information and filtering requirements.
discoveries.open_question: What level of granular detail will accessibility information provide (e.g., specific measurements vs. general tags)?

discoveries.title: Proactive Disruption Warnings
discoveries.discovery: Highlight planned engineering works or long-term disruptions upfront during the planning stage and suggest suitable alternatives.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 1 highlights the need for proactive disruption warnings and engineering work summaries.
discoveries.open_question: How frequently will engineering work schedules be updated and verified by SmartRail from all operators?

discoveries.title: Service and Occupancy Details
discoveries.discovery: Display information on available on-board services like WiFi, catering, and power sockets, along with estimated train occupancy levels.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 1 mentions displaying on-board services and occupancy levels.
discoveries.open_question: Will SmartRail provide predictive occupancy levels based on historical data and current booking trends, or just current real-time data?

discoveries.title: Integrated Onward Travel Information
discoveries.discovery: Provide basic information about local transport links at origin and destination stations.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 1 notes integrated onward travel and local transport links.

discoveries.title: Multi-operator Journey Handling
discoveries.discovery: Uncertainty regarding how SmartRail will handle scenarios where an optimal journey involves travel with multiple operators that do not traditionally integrate ticketing.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 1 asks how SmartRail will handle non-integrated multi-operator journeys.
discoveries.open_question: How will SmartRail handle scenarios where an optimal journey involves travel with multiple operators that don't traditionally integrate their ticketing?

discoveries.title: Visual Seat Selection
discoveries.discovery: Allow passengers to select specific seats from a visual coach layout highlighting amenities, accessible spaces, and proximity to toilets.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 2 discusses options to select specific seats and visual seat maps.

discoveries.title: Special Assistance Integration
discoveries.discovery: Provide a dedicated section within the booking process to request and confirm special assistance directly with clear confirmation messages.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 2 describes assistance integration during booking.
discoveries.open_question: Will the system differentiate between different types of assistance needs and tailor the request accordingly?

discoveries.title: Direct Retailer vs. Redirect Role
discoveries.discovery: It is unclear whether SmartRail will act as a direct retailer for all train tickets or redirect users to individual operator sites.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 2 asks if SmartRail will act as a direct retailer or redirect to individual operator sites.
discoveries.open_question: Will SmartRail act as a direct retailer for all train tickets, or will it redirect to individual operator sites for final purchase?

discoveries.title: Data Security and Privacy Protocols
discoveries.discovery: Protocols must be defined for data security and privacy when storing passenger payment details and personal information.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 2 question about data security and privacy protocols for payment and personal details.
discoveries.open_question: What protocols will be in place for data security and privacy when storing payment details and personal information?

discoveries.title: Proactive Notifications for Day of Travel
discoveries.discovery: Send push notifications for significant delays, cancellations, or platform changes affecting a specific booked journey.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 3 outlines proactive notifications for day of travel updates.
discoveries.open_question: What threshold constitutes a significant delay for a push notification and can passengers customize this?

discoveries.title: Signal Loss and Device Failure
discoveries.discovery: Passengers facing phone battery failure, missing tickets, or signal loss at the station when trying to present mobile tickets.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 3 mentions ticket troubles such as dying phone batteries or missing tickets, and asks about offline mode.
discoveries.open_question: Will SmartRail have an offline mode for displaying mobile tickets in case of signal loss at the station?

discoveries.title: Interactive Station Maps and Coach Stopping Positions
discoveries.discovery: Provide interactive, GPS-enabled station maps showing facilities, assistance points, accessible routes, and estimated coach stopping positions on the platform.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 4 covers interactive station maps and estimated coach stopping positions.
discoveries.open_question: What is the accuracy level of coach stopping position predictions given varied train lengths and platform designs?

discoveries.title: Facility and Lift Out-of-Order Alerts
discoveries.discovery: Real-time alerts for out-of-order station facilities such as lifts, escalators, and accessible toilets.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 4 mentions facility alerts for out-of-order station facilities.
discoveries.open_question: How will SmartRail ensure that real-time lift/escalator status is consistently and accurately reported from all stations?

discoveries.title: Real-Time Train Tracking and In-Journey Updates
discoveries.discovery: A live map showing the train's current location, speed, and estimated arrival times, alongside push notifications for delays and disruption explanations.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 5 specifies real-time train tracking and proactive in-journey updates.
discoveries.open_question: What level of detail will be provided in disruption explanations and how will this be communicated consistently?

discoveries.title: Discreet Issue Reporting on Board
discoveries.discovery: A discreet feature allowing passengers to report non-emergency issues like heating problems or anti-social behavior directly to on-board staff.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 5 mentions reporting non-emergency issues directly to on-board staff.
discoveries.open_question: What is the service level agreement for responses to issues reported via the app?

discoveries.title: Missed Connections and Connection Risks
discoveries.discovery: Delays on initial trains putting connections at risk or causing missed connections without clear alternative guidance or protected status.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 6 identifies risks of missed connections, unprotected connections, and lack of guidance.
discoveries.open_question: Will SmartRail clearly indicate if a connection is protected and what level of automatic re-booking will be facilitated?

discoveries.title: Centralized Compensation Claims (Delay Repay)
discoveries.discovery: A centralized, simplified process for claiming Delay Repay, potentially auto-populating journey details from booking history.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 8 details simplified compensation and centralized Delay Repay claims.
discoveries.open_question: Will SmartRail directly manage compensation claims or redirect to operators, and how will dispute resolution be handled?

discoveries.title: Consolidated Lost Property Search
discoveries.discovery: A consolidated lost property search portal across all participating operators to track and retrieve lost items.
discoveries.source_basis: Stage 8 notes centralized lost property search portal.
discoveries.open_question: Will the lost property portal require real-time updates from all operators, and how will its effectiveness be measured?
